chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Jameel ibn Darraj, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
There is no problem if the man departs during the first departure, then he stays in Makkah.
ai.seo_question: Can a pilgrim leave Mina early and stay in Makkah during Hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the flexibility in the Hajj ritual of staying in Mina, permitting a pilgrim to depart after the first sunset on the 12th of Dhu al-Hijjah and remain in Makkah, thereby avoiding the second night's stay. It reflects the Shia scholarly view that the 'later ones' (al-mu'akhkhirun) have the option to leave early without penalty, emphasizing ease in religious practice. This ruling is often discussed in contrast to the stricter interpretation requiring a full three days in Mina.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel Bin Darraj, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘There is no problem if the man departed (from Mina) during the first departure, then he stays in Makkah’.
en.sarwar: 6. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Jamil ibn Darraj who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
It is not harmful to depart in the first chance for departure, then stay in Makkah.’”
